_provenance: Hand-recorded evidence, not machine-generated. Produced by querying the arXiv search endpoint (https://arxiv.org/search/advanced, searchtype=all) on the scan date below, over the whole indexed window, and reading the 'Total of N entries' line. Kept as a committed file because the manuscript quotes these counts and a quoted count must live in the package. The endpoint is rate-limited and not re-queried by reproduce.sh; a reader who re-runs the queries is expected to obtain the same set at the same scan date.
